subject.title: feat(apple): copy or save rendered widgets as images from the chat transcript

question: Should transcript widgets on the Apple apps gain native image copy and save/share actions as a supported product capability?
rationale: This adds a durable user-facing native interaction rather than repairing an established broken contract, and the protected label requires explicit maintainer handling.

options.title: Sponsor with bounded safeguards
options.body: Accept the Apple-native export direction after the filename cap and signed-app proof establish a reliable user flow.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the existing view-only widget behavior until a broader transcript-export direction is approved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor with bounded safeguards
recommendation.body: Accept the Apple-native export direction after the filename cap and signed-app proof establish a reliable user flow.

likelyOwner.reason: The available current-history signal connects this contributor directly to the affected Apple widget implementation.
